configure-server.name: configure-server
configure-server.description: Configure channels, languages and more for your server notifications

languages.label: Notification languages
languages.description: One or more languages in which the notifications will be posted

tone.label: Bot tone
tone.description: The tone the bot will use when sending messages in this server

channel.label: Notification channel
channel.description: The channel to which the bot will post notifications to

name.name: name
name.description: A unique name for this notification

recurrence-pattern.name: recurrence-pattern
recurrence-pattern.description: The pattern after which the notification can be triggered again

recurrence-interval.name: recurrence-interval
recurrence-interval.description: The interval for the recurrence pattern

common.error:
## ⚠️ Something Went Wrong

An unexpected error occurred while processing your request. Please try again in a few moments, or reach out to a server administrator if the issue persists.

server-configuration.validation-failed:
## ⚠️ Validation Failed

Some of your settings couldn't be validated. Please check your inputs and try again.
server-configuration.created-or-updated:
## 🎉 Settings Saved
> Changes will take effect the next time the bot posts.

Need to make adjustments? You can update your settings again anytime with </<%= it.commandName %>:<%= it.commandId %>>.
server-configuration.missing-permission:
## 🛡️ Permission Denied

You do not have the required permissions to perform this action. Please contact a server administrator if you believe this is an error.

notification-create.created:
## 🎉 Notification Created
> This notification will be checked the next time the bot looks for matching movies.

Your new notification `<%= it.name %>` has been created successfully. You will be notified once a movie matching `<%= it.searchTerm %>` is found.
Need to make adjustments? You can update this notification anytime with </<%= it.updateCommandName %>:<%= it.commandId %>> or delete it with </<%= it.deleteCommandName %>:<%= it.commandId %>>.

notification-delete.deleted:
## 🗑️ Notification Deleted

The notification `<%= it.name %>` has been successfully deleted.

notification-update.updated:
## 🎉 Notification Updated
> This notification will be checked the next time the bot looks for matching movies.

Your notification `<%= it.name %>` has been successfully updated with the following settings:
- **Search term**: `<%= it.key %>`
- **Recurrence pattern**: `<%= it.recurrencePattern %>`
- **Recurrence interval**: `<%= it.recurrenceInterval %>`
